slots.purpose: Hero and social share image: a same-sex couple's ceremony, or the ceremony set-up awaiting them, at a Greek island venue, signalling warmth, equality and luxury from the first glance.
slots.shot_brief: Landscape 3:2. Fallback with no people: the same venue's ceremony set-up (two chairs or an open aisle, white florals, olive branches, sea beyond), no signage. People only from a licensed real wedding with written couple consent (and guest consent if identifiable) recorded in library-index.csv; never staged with AI, never stock models presented as a real couple. Source: the venue's own media kit with written permission (Gmail draft request, never sent by an agent), or licensed premium stock bought by a human and added to library-index.csv.
